item.title: Implement retry_budget.py to SPEC.md and add focused tests
item.brief: Implement `retry_budget.py` according to the repository's `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API exactly. Handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basics. Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests and checks. Commit the completed work as requested; the repository pipeline will handle shipping. Acceptance criteria: (1) behavior and API match SPEC.md, including all specified errors and boundaries; (2) focused tests cover those cases and pass; (3) standard-library only; (4) commit is produced by the pipeline.

evidence.caption: Before, the three existing tests errored on NotImplementedError; after implementation, all ten focused tests pass.

pr.body: Implemented the documented retry_delay API in retry_budget.py using only the standard library. Validation runs before exhaustion checks; capped backoff doubles incrementally without constructing huge powers; Retry-After remains an uncapped minimum; and a retry is rejected when its start would be at or beyond the budget. Added tests for invalid types/ranges, exhausted attempts, huge attempt counts, zero values, cap behavior, retry floors, and strict deadlines. Verified with python3 -m unittest -v (10 passed), python3 -m py_compile retry_budget.py test_retry_budget.py, and git diff --check. The pre-change suite had 3 errors because the implementation was a stub. No known limitations.
